paper.title: Conversational Contextual Bandit: Algorithm and Application

unmapped: In addition to bandit feedback on the chosen arm, the learner occasionally (b(t) times up to round t, b(t) <= t) queries key-terms and observes noisy feedback whose mean is a weighted average of arm means, E[r~_{k,t}] = sum_a w_{a,k}/sum_a' w_{a',k} E[r_{a,t}]
The learner knows the weighted bipartite graph (arms, key-terms, W) and the conversation frequency function b(t)
Learner uses a bound on the key-term-level parameter norm ||theta~_*||_2 in its confidence width
settings.definition_quote: Consider a finite set of $N \in \mathbb{N}_+$ arms denoted by $\mathcal{A}$ and a finite set of $K \in \mathbb{N}_+$ key-terms denoted by $\mathcal{K}$. The relationships between the arms and the key-terms are characterized by a weighted bipartite graph $(\mathcal{A}, \mathcal{K}, \bm{W})$ ... At each round $t=1,\ldots, T$, the agent is given a subset of arms $\mathcal{A}_t \subseteq \mathcal{A}$, and each arm $a \in \mathcal{A}_t$ is specified by a contextual vector $\bm{x}_{a,t} \in \mathbb{R}^d$ ... $\|\bm{x}_{a,t}\|_2=1$. ... If $q(t)=1$, the agent conducts $\lfloor b(t)- b(t-1) \rfloor$ conversations with the user.

bound.expression: 2*(sqrt(lam_bal)*sqrt(d*log((1 + lam_bal*T/((1 - lam_bal)*d))/delta)) + 2*sqrt((1 - lam_bal)/lam_bal)*S_tilde + (1 - sqrt(lam_bal))*sqrt(d*log(6) + log(2*b_T/delta)))*sqrt(T*d*log(1 + lam_bal*T/(d*(1 - lam_bal))))

symbols.lam_bal: lambda in [0,0.5], weight balancing arm-level rewards vs key-term-level estimate
symbols.S_tilde: ||theta~_*||_2, norm of the key-term-level true parameter
symbols.b_T: number of conversations b(t) (written b(t) in the theorem, presumably up to round T)

conditions: noise eps_t and key-term noise are conditionally 1-sub-Gaussian
conversational feedback mean is weighted average of arm means per the key-term model

source.label: thm:regret_bound_fixed_scenario
source.quote: Assume that $\lambda\in [0,0.5]$, $\tilde{\lambda} \geq \frac{2(1-\lambda)}{\lambda(1-\sqrt{\lambda})^2}$, with the key-term selection strategy defined in Eq.~(\ref{equ:optimized_strategy}), then with probability $1-\sigma$, ConUCB has the following regret upper bound. R(T) \leq 2( \sqrt{\lambda} \sqrt{d\log((1+\frac{\lambda T}{(1-\lambda)d})/\sigma)} + 2\sqrt{\frac{1-\lambda}{\lambda}}\|\tilde{\theta}_*\|_2 + (1-\sqrt{\lambda})\sqrt{ d\log 6+\log(\frac{2b(t)}{\sigma}) }) \sqrt{Td \log(1+\frac{\lambda T}{d(1-\lambda)})}.

results.notes: Paper's sigma is the failure probability (delta). Regret defined via expectations against per-round best arm; bound holds w.p. 1-delta. Proof relies on the approximation theta_* ≈ theta~_* (arm-level and key-term-level parameters equal), so the result effectively assumes this. Paper summarizes as O(((1-sqrt(lambda))sqrt(d+log T) + sqrt(lambda d log T)) sqrt(dT log T)). Printed number copied from annotation.
